basis.orientation: The official manual states that IMU acceleration and angular-velocity directions are the same as the point-cloud coordinates; therefore R_lidar_imu is identity.
basis.translation: The official manual gives the IMU chip position in point-cloud coordinates as x=11.0 mm, y=23.29 mm, z=-44.12 mm; converted to metres this is the translation of the IMU origin in the LiDAR frame.
